name: Support subscription renewal notice policy example
answer:
Customers receive an email reminder 7 days before annual renewal.
Customers receive a reminder 30 days before every renewal.
Customers receive a free gift card with every support interaction.

sources.title: Support Subscription Renewal Notice Policy
sources.content:
Customers receive an email reminder 7 days before annual renewal.
Customers receive renewal reminders when required by the plan terms.
Renewal reminders do not include a guaranteed refund; refund eligibility follows the applicable plan policy.
